paite: Jeriko khua Israel suante ziak in akikhak bikbek a; kuamah apawt kei ua, kuamah leng alut kei uh.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Sualna

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "En in, Jeriko leh akumpipa uh leh amihat hangsante uh na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi.
Galdoumi tengteng in khopi kimvel in khatvei na va velsuak phot ding uh. Huchibang in ni guk sung na hih ding uh ahi.
Siampu sagih in bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih atawi ding ua, ani sagih ni in khopi sagihvei na velsuak ding ua, siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, belampa kii amutging uh na zak chiang un, mipi tengteng ngaihtak in kikou uhen. Huchi in khopi kulhbaang achim dia, mipi amau mazawn chiat ah apaitou ding uh," achi hi.
Nun tapa Joshua in siampute asam a, akiang uah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, siampu sagih in TOUPA bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi uhen," achi hi.
Ama'n mipite kiang ah, "Pai zel unla, khopi velsuak un, mi kigalthuamte TOUPA bawm malam ah pai zel uhen,” achi hi.
Hichi ahong hita a, Joshua in mipite kiang a thu agen khit in TOUPA ma a belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai zel ua, pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Kimvelna

paite: Mi kigalthuamte pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi. 9 Mi kigalthuamte pengkul mut siampute ma ah apai ua, nungdal mite'n bawm amasuan ua, siampute'n pai kawm in pengkul amut uhi.

Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou kei unla, na aw uh leng zak hi kei hen. Kikou dia thu ka hon piak ni atun mateng na kam ua pan thu pawt kei hen. Huai hun chiang in na kikou ding uh," chi in thu apia hi.
TOUPA bawm khopi khatvei velh in avelsuaksak a; giahphual ah apai ua, giahphual ah agiak nawn uhi.
Joshua zingkhang in athou a, siampute'n TOUPA bawm azawng uhi.

TOUPA bawm ma ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai ua, pengkul amut uhi. Ama uah mi kigalthuamte apai ua; nungdalte'n TOUPA bawm ahon masuan ua, siampute'n apai kawm un pengkul amut uhi.
Ani nih ni in khopi khatvei avelsuak nawn ua, agiahphual uah akik nawn uh. Huchibang in ni guk ahih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in zingkhang, phalvak in athou ua, ahihdan ngei mah un sagihvei avelsuak ua; huai ni kia in khopi sagihvei avelsuak uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, asagihveina a siampute'n pengkul amuttak un Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou un: TOUPA'N khopi ahon pe khinta hi.
Khopi leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA hamsiat ahi. Rahab kizuaknu kia, amah leh a-insung a akiang a om tengteng bel i misawlte uh ana sel ziak in hinghawi ding ahi.
Nou zaw hamsiat thilte a pan kihuikhe hiau un, huchi lou in zaw, hamsiat thilte la in noumau mah hamsiat in na omloh kha ding uhi. Israelte giahphual hamsiat a omsak in na buaisak kha ding uhi.
Dangkasik, dangka-eng, dal leh sik tui-um belsuan teng ahihleh TOUPA a tuam ahi vek hi. TOUPA sum in akoih ding ahi," achi hi.

Mipite akikou ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite'n pengkul ging azaktak un, ngaihtak in akikou ua, kulhbaang achimta hi. Huchi in mipite amazawn chiat uah apaitou ua, khopi ah alut ua, khopi alata uhi.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Lakna

paite: Khopi sung a mi tengteng, numei leh pasal, atek- akhang, bawngtal, belam leh sabiltung teng namsau in asatlum vek uhi.
Joshua in mi nih, gam va enkhete kiang ah, "Huai kizuaknu inn ah va lut unla, akiang a na kichiamsa bang un huai numei leh aneih teng hon pikhia un," achi hi.
heading: Rahab Inkuan Hotdamna

paite: Enkhe mi tangvalte ava lut ua, Rahab, anu leh pa, asangamte leh aneih teng ahon pikhia ua, atanau teng leng ahon pikhia ua; Israelte giahphual polam ah a-omsak uhi.
Khopi leh asung a thil om teng mei in ahal vek ua; dangkasik, dangka-eng, sum-eng leh sik tui-um belsuan teng kia TOUPA' inn a sumkoihna ah akoih uhi.
Himahleh Joshua in Jeriko khua enkhe dia amisawlte ana humbit ziak in, Rahab kizuaknu leh aneih teng leh apa inkuante Joshua in ahinghawi vek a; Israelte lak ah tuni tan in ateng lai uhi.

Huai lai in Joshua in, Hiai Jeriko khopi hon lam nawn peuhmah TOUPA ma ah hamsiat in om hen. Asuangphum phummi ta masa leh akulhbaang kongpite tungkhemi ta tumpen leng hamsiat in om hen, chi in amaute ahilh chiatchiat hi.
heading: Jeriko Hamsiatna / (1 Kum 16.34)

paite: Joshua kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; gam pumpi ah amin hong thangta hi.
